incidents.text: UKMTO WARNING 078-26 - SUSPICIOUS ACTIVITY Report Date: 01 Jul 2026 Report Time:0945UTC Issue Date: 01 Jul 2026 Source: Master UKMTO has received a report of an incident 85NM south of Balhaf, Yemen. The Master of a tanker had reported a small craft approached the vessel on the port quarter at 2NM. The small craft was described as having a low freeboard and orange interior with 4 POB. The small craft has now left the vicinity proceeding south. The crew are reported as safe and the vessel is continuing on its voyage. Authorities are investigating. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO.

UKMTO WARNING 079-26 ATTACK Report Date: 05 Jul 2026 Report Time: 0719UTC UKMTO has received a report of an incident 30NM southwest of Al Hudaydah, Yemen. A cargo vessel has triggered a distress alert stating that they are under attack by unknown armed assailants. Authorities are investigating. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO.

UKMTO WARNING 080-26 - ATTACK Report Date: 06 Jul 2026 Report Time: 2119UTC UKMTO has received a report of an incident 8NM east of Limah, Oman. A tanker has reported being hit by an unknown projectile on the port side causing a fire, whilst travelling southbound. No casualties or environmental impact reported. Authorities are investigating. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO.

UKMTO_WARNING_81-26. UKMTO has received a report of an incident involving a tanker transiting the Strait of Hormuz. The tanker was struck by an unidentified projectile and is believed to have structural damage. No casualties or environmental impact reported. UKMTO continues to investigate. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO.

UKMTO_WARNING_82-26. UKMTO has received a report of a further incident involving a tanker transiting the Strait of Hormuz. The tanker was struck by an unknown Uncrewed Aerial Vehicle (UAV) and has sustained minor structural damage. No casualties or environmental impact reported, and vessel is continuing to its next port of call. UKMTO continues to investigate. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO.

UKMTO has received a report of an incident 9NM east of Oman. Military authorities have reported that a container ship has sustained damage to the rear of the vessel which has caused a fire onboard. Authorities are investigating. UPDATE 001: UKMTO has been informed by military authorities and the CSO of the vessel that the crew have abandoned the vessel and are currently embarked in a lifeboat. UPDATE 002: UKMTO has spoken to the CSO of the container ship who confirms that the crew has been rescued by local authorities. Authorities continue to investigate. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO.

UKMTO WARNING 084-26 - SUSPICIOUS ACTIVITY Report Date:13 Jul 2026 Report Time:1019UTC UKMTO has received a report of an incident 50NM south of Aden, Yemen. A tanker travelling east in the IRTC has reported being approached by 6 small boats approaching from the starboard side. One small boat has closed to 5 cables and the AST on board the tanker has fired warning shots. The other 5 small boats have remained at 1NM.

UKMTO WARNING 085-26 - ATTACK Report Date: 13 Jul 2026 Report Time: 2104 UTC Issue Date: 13 Jul 2026 Source: Master UKMTO has received a report of an incident 40NM northeast of Qalhat, Oman. The Master of a Tanker reports being hit by an unknown projectile on the starboard side engine room. All crew are safe and accounted for with no environmental impact reported. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO. Authorities continue to investigate.

UKMTO HIJACK 090-26 - UKMTO has received a report of an incident 65NM south of Al Mukalla, Yemen. Military authorities have reported that the vessel was boarded by unauthorised personnel whilst transiting east in the Gulf of Aden. Authorities are investigating. UPDATE 001 – Military authorities have reported to UKMTO that the vessel involved has been maneuvered into Somalian territorial waters. UKMTO has re-classified this incident as Hijack

UKMTO ATTACK 092-26 - UKMTO has received a report of an incident 8NM northwest of Kumzar, Oman. UKMTO have received information from military authorities that a vessel is on fire. The cause of the fire has not been verified as this time. Update – 001 UKMTO has reclassified as an Attack. The CSO has confirmed the vessel was struck by an unknown projectile. The crew safely abandoned the vessel and have been recovered by a tug boat. The fire has not been extinguished and the vessel is currently adrift. There is no reported environmental impact. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO while authorities investigate.

Authorities are investigating.
